title: Sales Coaching Framework: Choose a Model, Then Run It Every Week
summary: A sales coaching framework sets what managers coach, how each session runs, and how change gets checked. Compare GROW and other models, then run a weekly loop.
body_markdown:
Question


One answer, and what it points to


Another answer, and what it points to


What are managers mostly trying to change right now?


Call behavior: lead with the evidence, practice, check loop and use GROW inside it


Deal outcomes or forecast accuracy: lead with Did-Doing-Do for deals and AOR for pipeline


How much call evidence do managers have?


Recorded calls and scorecards: start every skill session from a call moment


Little or none: start from a practice attempt, and add call review when recordings exist


How experienced are the reps?


Mostly new: show what good looks like before asking GROW questions


Mostly experienced: let the rep pick the moment and lead the Options step


How fast do deals move?


Many short calls a week: check the behavior on calls in the same week


A few long deals: check it at the next meeting in the same stage


Who defines the behaviors?


Enablement: managers coach to those definitions and report what they see


Each manager: agree on shared definitions before anyone scores calls
